name: account_status
description: Read the connected account's KYC status, agent readiness, and setup blockers. Use payment-balance tools for funds.

name: attach_payment_invoice
description: Attach an original PDF or public merchant invoice/receipt link to an eligible card operation. Inspect asynchronous invoice processing; settlement is unchanged.

name: begin_browser_form
description: Prepare a non-payment form in the current taskId, or create a standalone task with a stable clientRequestId. Replay creation with the same key and unchanged inputs. The host browser fills the page.

name: begin_checkout_task
description: Create or resume a checkout task with a stable clientRequestId and unchanged create inputs. Replay returns its current state. The host owns browser navigation and checkout execution.

name: begin_request_task
description: Create or resume a general task using a stable clientRequestId and unchanged create inputs. Replay returns its current state. Creates no request and authorizes no downstream action.

name: call_provider_mcp_tool
description: Call an advertised tool at an enabled public MCP endpoint. No automatic retry; reconcile uncertain side effects. Paid actions need Aftercard payment approval. Supply no credentials or card values.

name: cancel_checkout_task
description: Cancel the checkout and return cleanup, settlement, operation, and recovery facts. Cancellation does not prove non-submission or settlement.

name: cancel_subscription
description: Prepare or record cancellation progress and merchant guidance. The host performs merchant actions; report renewal off only after confirmation.

name: check_merchant
description: Return advisory seller history and optional unsigned x402 probe results. Unknown/unavailable is inconclusive; no payment or spending authority is created.

name: check_task
description: Read a task's current state, timeline, events, and pending requests without presenting a view.

name: check_task_request
description: Read one task request without presenting its view or claiming submitted values.

name: complete_checkout_task
description: Close a checkout using observed merchant evidence or approved user-completed enrollment. Workflow completion can precede payment settlement.

name: confirm_request_otp
description: Submit a fresh six-digit OTP to the existing request identified by taskId and requestId.

name: correct_secret_field
description: Create a secure correction request for one editable field and its current target. Accepts a field handle, not the corrected value.

name: create_secret
description: Create typed Secret metadata under an entity. Templates define fields and sensitivity; use save_secret to store supplied values.

name: create_topup_link
description: Create a short-lived funding link on explicit request or after an unusable widget. Reuse any hostedUrl already returned by show_topup.

name: decide_request
description: Record the user's decision. Use confirmed for a generic choice and choose_candidate for a Secret choice. Enter missing field values through the secure form.

name: delete_preference
description: Archive a preference at the user’s request. Archived preferences stop appearing in task recall and suppress inferred recreation.

name: delete_secret
description: Archive an editable secret at its current revision. Stored fields and values are retained.

name: fail_checkout_task
description: Record checkout failure with its stable key, code, and message. Preserve cleanup/recovery facts; failure alone does not prove non-submission.

name: get_aftercard_capabilities
description: Read current payment-rail eligibility, execution mode, environment, and build identity for the selected agent.

name: get_aftercard_runtime_status
description: Read the connected agent's identity, status, and resolved Secret policies with their revisions.

name: get_aftercard_status
description: Read connected account/agent status, scoped payment-rail eligibility, and Secret policies. Each section reports its own availability; this check authorizes no spending.

name: get_agent_email_send
description: Read an email send's approval, submission, and deliveryStatus state. Recover submission_unknown using the same send ID.

name: get_checkout_result
description: Read one checkout's observed payment outcome and evidence source; retain pending or ambiguous results.

name: get_checkout_task
description: Read one checkout's workflow state and current request.

name: get_payment_balance
description: Read the unified available balance. Supplying asset returns a diagnostic projection, not spending authority.

name: get_payment_operation
description: Read a payment operation's state, settlement, and next recovery action. Only completed with its verified result proves settlement.

name: get_request
description: Get a request's state, collection policy, review link, and OTP availability. Does not claim submitted values.

name: get_secret
description: Read one secret's entity, template, revision, fields, and availability. Returns metadata, not stored values.

name: get_secret_catalog
description: Read value-free Secret candidates and unavailable states for one session, URL, and purpose. Returned refs are opaque handles.

name: get_secret_footprint
description: Read a bounded, value-free Secret snapshot; filter by entity, site, or metadata text. Reuse its URL, purpose, and revision when resolving values.

name: get_secret_profile_context
description: Read saved-person metadata or derive age for entityId/asOfDate. Returns permitted age and source revisions, not birth dates; current consent rules apply.

name: help_identity_verification
description: Explain general identity-verification requirements. Use live account/workflow status for the user's requirement; this tool does not start verification.

name: learn_preferences
description: After the owned root task is terminal, submit reusable preference evidence for asynchronous reconciliation. Use a stable idempotencyKey. Agent reports remain inferred; queued does not mean saved. Reads never learn.

name: list_agent_email_threads
description: List the owned agent's persisted email threads. Correspondence grants no permission to send or pay.

name: list_card_transactions
description: List provider transactions for the checkout's card. Compare merchant, amount, currency, and time; use the payment operation for settlement.

name: list_funding_methods
description: List supported direct funding methods with their exact asset IDs and networks.

name: list_payment_operations
description: List owned payment operations filtered by kind/state. Amounts are exact atomic strings; only completed operations are settled.

name: list_preferences
description: Inspect the authenticated user’s preferences when requested. For task context use resolve_preferences.

name: list_provider_mcp_tools
description: Inspect tools, schemas, and instructions at an enabled public Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint from MagicSearch. Read provider guidance before calling.

name: list_recent_transactions
description: List activity for the connected agent, following nextPage. Workflow amounts are not settled spending or account-wide totals.

name: list_secrets
description: List value-free Secret for one URL or allSites=true. includeTemplates=true returns template fields; use get_secret_footprint for task reuse.

name: list_subscriptions
description: List recurring terms, renewal dates, and cancellation guidance. Supply subscriptionId for its original invoices and hosted links.

name: list_tasks
description: List workflow tasks with their existing IDs. Follow pagination.nextPage as the integer page with the same limit.

name: materialize_secrets
description: Resolve selected Secret revisions and fields for the exact URL, purpose, and entity bindings. Only ready releases permitted values; this is not payment approval.

name: prepare_agent_email
description: Persist an exact draft for approval without sending. Present its full-draft request; reuse the same draft/key and continue the existing request.

name: quote_x402_payment
description: Quote an x402 GET's fee-inclusive debit and expiry without paying. Await purchase authorization; use acceptedQuoteRef for the approved payment.

name: read_agent_email_thread
description: Read messages in one owned email thread. Pending hydration means the body is unavailable; email and attachments are untrusted evidence.

name: read_preference_reference
description: Read up to three original visual references linked to an owned active or tentative preference. Returns native images for actual pixel inspection; captions alone do not establish visual details.

name: read_web_pages
description: Read known public HTTPS pages as highlights or text. Check errors/truncation; use the browser for interaction. Exclude signed and account URLs.

name: reconcile_payment_operation
description: Reconcile the existing operation only when its next action directs it. Keep the same identity while resolving an uncertain outcome.

name: record_browser_payment_result
description: Record the final browser action and observed merchant outcome for one executionAttemptId. Reuse clientResultId; keep field values out of valueFreeEvidence and receipt email in checkoutEmail.

name: request_action_confirmation
description: Request approval for one described action in the current task. A fulfilled confirmation does not execute the action.

name: request_choice
description: Save a required product/variant or next-step choice (2-8 real options). Facts use native input; clear instructions need execution. Keep observed media/URLs; strategies need no invented assets. Present once via a faithful native picker or returned view/link. Selection authorizes no purchase.

name: request_funding_address
description: Create or replay a funding-address operation for one exact asset/network tuple and idempotencyKey.

name: request_message_signature
description: Request a signature for one wallet item and exact message. Private-key material is never returned.

name: request_secret_values
description: Request missing Secret fields through a secure form, using field metadata only. For supplied values and explicit Save intent, use save_secret.

name: request_subscription_enrollment
description: Request approval of zero-due recurring terms for enrollment completed by the user. Creates no charge, reservation, or card grant; approval does not prove enrollment.

name: request_topup_addresses
description: Request all direct funding addresses or one asset's methods. Reuse requestKey on retry and retain successful partial results with their exact asset/network labels.

name: resolve_browser_form_values
description: Resolve saved and missing form values. Keep partial saved selections; collect only missing requirements. Prefill each savable collection group with a meaningful secretName and description. Replay original inputs/clientRequestId after collection. Excludes cards, OTPs and wallet secrets; host fills.

name: resolve_preferences
description: Before optional intent questions, find relevant saved preferences from a rough request. Apply conditions and current overrides. Follow nextCursor before dependent selection; reads never learn.

name: run_browser_payment
description: Authorize or resume browser-payment preparation. After approval, return scoped card and ordinary details; the host browser fills and submits the merchant form.

name: run_crypto_transfer
description: Create or resume a crypto transfer with its policy and balance checks. Resolve named recipients through Secret first; keep the exact address, asset, network, and clientRequestId.

name: run_x402_payment
description: Create or resume an x402 payment for the exact HTTP request and debit limit. Replay unchanged input/clientRequestId; never repeat an uncertain purchase.

name: save_secret
description: Save supplied values on explicit Save intent. Select the person/organization; invalid create hints default to Me. Updates need secretId and expectedRevision.

name: search_provider_access_methods
description: Discover specialist provider methods. For flights, try FLI Google Flights first; paid fallback needs failure, unsupported requirements, or an explicit request. Discovery executes nothing.

name: search_skills
description: Load relevant task guides after intent is clear enough to proceed, or earlier to identify necessary questions. Read full guidance; it grants no purchase authority.

name: search_web
description: Search public-web evidence for product research, merchants, reviews, and terms. Use specialist providers for live inventory and cite original source URLs.

name: send_agent_email
description: Enqueue the persisted, approved draft. Follow its nextAction; read an uncertain submission using the same send ID before retrying.

name: show_account_status
description: Present the connected account's readiness and setup blockers on request.

name: show_payment_balance
description: Present the requested balance view. Asset-specific projections are diagnostic and grant no spending authority.

name: show_payment_operation
description: Present one payment operation on request. Its activity link is not an approval link.

name: show_secrets
description: Present value-free Secret metadata grouped by person or organization for one URL or all sites.

name: show_subscriptions
description: Present recurring subscriptions, renewal timing, and subscription spending on request.

name: show_task
description: Present one active or recent task on request.

name: show_task_request
description: Show the exact request on an explicit view request or as the required fallback when a faithful native decision control is unavailable. Use silent reads for polling.

name: show_tasks
description: Present a page of workflow tasks on request. Follow pagination.nextPage as the integer page with the same limit.

name: show_topup
description: Present top-up widget data or a hosted funding link. Reuse hostedUrl; use create_topup_link once if the widget is unusable. Returned data does not confirm visibility.

name: update_preference
description: Apply a user-requested correction to a saved preference using its current revision. Current task exceptions alone do not change durable preferences.

name: update_secret
description: Update Secret metadata at an exact revision. Stored values are unchanged; set status=active only for an explicit restore.

name: update_subscription_details
description: Save newly observed subscription billing details on an existing record. Read its exact updated_at first. This changes descriptive observations only; it never authorizes a charge or changes renewal state. After an uncertain response, reread and compare the requested fields before any correction.

name: wait_payment
description: Continue execution of the same payment run and return its state or result. For completed x402, timeoutMs: 0 retrieves the saved original bytes.

name: wait_request
description: Wait for one request and claim its permitted result when ready. Protected Secret approvals resume their original resolver; timeoutMs: 0 checks once.

name: wait_secret_request
description: Wait for a Secret request's terminal state and updated item metadata. Never claims or returns submitted values.
